Enrollment.on_value: def (device_info,attr_list,ctx) if attr_list['ZoneState'] != 1 || attr_list['IASCIEAddress'] != ctx.bridge_address var endpoint = attr_list.find('Endpoint',1) ctx.log(f'not enrolled with this bridge, enrolling endpoint {endpoint}') ctx.cmd(f'ZbCIE {device_info.deviceid},{endpoint}') ctx.cmd(f'ZbEnroll {device_info.deviceid},{endpoint}') end end
